$comment: The operator's own answer to Gate 0. `runtime/mvp_runtime/crypto/live_candidate_ack.py` owns the record; `feedback.build_performance_report` still owns the computed measurement and is never overwritten by this — the two are reported side by side.
title: Crypto Live-Candidate Gate Acknowledgement v0.1
description: An operator-registered, self-hashed, expiring statement that Gate 0 — 'paper trading by this runtime shows positive expectancy over a sustained window' — has been checked and accepted BY A PERSON for a named set of strategies. docs/runtime-contracts/CRYPTO_LIVE_EXECUTION_V0.1.md states Gate 0 as an item on the operator go-live checklist, to be checked on the dashboard; #400/#409 turned it into an automatic code refusal computed over a pool aggregate, which cannot distinguish a retired strategy's losses from a routable one's and refuses every strategy's entries for any one strategy's record. This record returns the judgement to the operator without removing the gate: with nothing registered the computed answer stands unchanged, and the acknowledgement is bound to the exact routable set it was signed for, so promoting or demoting a strategy voids it. Registering one grants no permission by itself — the live_trading grant, the confirmation phrase, the canary evidence, the registered budget, the loss breakers and both kill switches all still stand.

acknowledged_strategy_ids.description: The routable strategy ids this acknowledgement was signed for, sorted. The guard re-checks them against the live pool: an acknowledgement applies only while the routable set is EXACTLY this set, so promoting a strategy or letting the ladder demote one voids it and Gate 0 returns to its computed answer. That is what stops a signature for one pool from silently authorising the next one.

reason.description: What the operator checked, in their own words. Required: this record is a person overriding a measurement that says otherwise, and a record that cannot say on what basis leaves an audit trail nobody can re-read.

valid_until.description: Acknowledgements expire. Past this the gate returns to its computed answer rather than staying open — a checklist tick is a judgement about a moment, and the moment passes.
